messages:
alice-partners: Heads-up 1: packaging checklist for the Snowflake + Databricks + vector-DB bundle we promised the partner. Want to lock the artifact formats and metadata fields so the marketplace review goes smoothly.

ryan-ps: Quick status: we've got a Delta export from the ETL demo pipeline and a CSV export. Also exported precomputed embeddings (float32) for 8k docs. Need to confirm embedding dims (should be 1024).

marta-legal: Marta (legal) here: two compliance items 1: (1) README must include the data provenance statement; (2) marketplace tile must show contact for data removal requests. No real user data in public packages.

leo-eng: Notes from runtime: Snowflake listings prefer a sample Snowflake share or at least a signed URL to staged CSVs. Databricks wants Delta + manifest. For vector DB adapters (we're targeting Qdrant and Milvus), include an adapter script per DB and a small validation script that returns a top-k for a test query. Also include a checksum for the embeddings file to prevent corrupt uploads.

nina-docs: Docs ask: short quickstart for each surface (Snowflake SQL, Databricks notebook, Qdrant python). Also add a troubleshooting section: "common import errors" (encoding, parquet/Delta mismatch, dimension mismatch).

alice-partners: Proposed artifact list:
- bundle/metadata.json (includes license, model used for embeddings, embedding-dim, contact)
- data/full_delta/ (Delta files)
- data/full_csv/full_synthetic_8k.csv
- embeddings/embeddings_8k.npy (float32) + embeddings.sha256
- adapters/qdrant_insert.py, milvus_insert.py
- notebooks/snowflake_quickstart.ipynb, databricks_quickstart.ipynb, qdrant_demo.ipynb
- README.md and LICENSE.txt
Can we all sanity-check?

ryan-ps: That looks good. Suggest adding embedding-config.txt with model name, model-hash, tokenizer-hash to avoid ambiguity when customers try to re-embed. Also add a small "mini.zip" with 100 rows for a fast demo.

marta-legal: License: use "Redwood Demo License v1 (evaluation only)" plus a short clause prohibiting redistribution. I will DM the exact text. Also confirm we do not include any telemetry keys or logs.

leo-eng: Implementation detail: for Delta export include a _delta_log manifest file. For Snowflake provide a CREATE TABLE + COPY INTO example that references a staged URL. I'll draft SQL snippets. Also note: Qdrant SDK versions matter; pin to >=1.18 in requirements.txt.

nina-docs: Docs owner: I'll write README + notebooks if I get the exact S3/Share paths and the embedding-config file. ETA two business days.

alice-partners: Timeline:
- Ryan: upload finalized artifacts + mini.zip (due +2 days)
- Leo: SQL snippets + validation scripts (due +3 days)
- Marta: license blurb + marketplace compliance checklist (due +3 days)
- Nina: docs + notebooks draft (due +4 days)
I'll set a 20-min check-in in 4 days.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: Marketplace submissions require the metadata.json to contain: "license","contact_email","data_provenance","model_used","embedding_dim". See internal guide: https://marketplace.redwood.internal/packaging-guide

ryan-ps: Uploading to staging now: s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/2367909999/ - mini.zip is uploaded. Will push full artifacts after CI passes dimension check.

marta-legal: Also flagging EU residency: if partner targets EU region, include a residency note and ensure no bundled logs with IPs.

leo-eng: QA note: I'll run the mini.zip through our import workflow and post the ingestion log. If vector insert fails due to version mismatch, we'll include a pinned container image with the adapter.

alice-partners: Great. If nothing blocks, we'll aim to submit the draft listing for internal review on day +6. Ping me if anything slips.
